plan: In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the dominant strategy is to bid up to my true value. Since the third-price auction mechanism means I only pay the third-highest bid, I want to bid close to my true value of $48 to maximize potential profit. However, I'll slightly shade my bid to account for potential strategic behavior by other bidders. I'll bid just under my true value to protect against overpaying.
